title: The Plan to Welcome a New Student
youtube_title: The Plan to Welcome a New Student | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: The best answer sometimes starts with hearing the whole thing.
summary: At a bedroom at lamp time, story not started yet, Auntie Luz begins to tell Eko about plan to welcome someone, with the listening part included. Eko wants to interrupt with bigger news, but listens all the way to the last sentence, asks one real question, and only then shares something small of their own.
